steps.caption: Settings
steps.narration: Turn on texting, so the CRM can text your clients, and text you.

steps.caption: Configured
steps.narration: In Settings, scroll down to the SMS card. Configured means texting is ready to use.

steps.caption: Which number
steps.narration: First, choose which number your texts come from.

steps.caption: Your own number
steps.narration: Texting clients needs a number of your own. It goes here.

steps.caption: Text estimates to clients
steps.narration: Switch on Text estimates to clients. When you send a bid, the client also gets a text with a link.

steps.caption: Text me
steps.narration: Switch on Text me when a bid is signed or money lands, to get those alerts on your phone.

steps.caption: Your consent
steps.narration: Texts to you also need your consent. That is this tick box, above the SMS card.

steps.caption: A test number
steps.narration: To check it works, type a mobile number under Send a test text.

steps.caption: Sent
steps.narration: A note confirms that the test went out.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: All of this is in Settings, in the left menu.

youtube.title: How to turn on texting for clients and alerts | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Set up texting in ConstructHUB CRM: choose the number your texts come from, switch on texting estimates to clients and alerts to your own phone, and send a test text. Recorded in a demo workspace where texting is already set up; no real text is sent.
